text: At its meeting on July 23, 2019, the Board discussed Municipal Car Park 673, 2204-2212 Eglinton Avenue West and requested that staff consult with the local Councillor, the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and the Deputy City Manager, Corporate Services, on including the lands of Municipal Car Park 673, located at 2204-2212 Eglinton Avenue West, in the ongoing review of City-owned assets for the Housing Now Initiative and to report to the Board with an update. No substantive update has been provided as of yet.

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Requested the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to report to the Board at its meeting in September 2020 with an update on the discussions with the local Councillor, the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO, and the Deputy City Manager, Corporate Services, on Municipal Car Park 673 located at 2204-2212 Eglinton Avenue West. 2. Requested the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, to provide an update to the Board during its meeting on July 24, 2020 regarding Municipal Car Park 673 located at 2204-2212 Eglinton Avenue West.
